title: Apple A-series iPhone chip transistor count (billions)

source.name: Apple A-series chip transistor counts, as disclosed at Apple keynotes and product pages

notes: Figures as announced by Apple for each chip generation: A9 (iPhone 6s, 2015) ~2.0B, A10 Fusion (2016) ~3.3B, A11 Bionic (2017) 4.3B, A12 Bionic (2018) 6.9B, A13 Bionic (2019) 8.5B, A14 Bionic (2020) 11.8B, A16 Bionic (2022) 16B, A17 Pro (2023) 19B.
